# Canonical guide: /CONTRIBUTING.md
# This file exists so GitHub finds the same rules under .github/.

Contributions follow the repository root [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [docs/charter.md](../docs/charter.md).

- The site stays free. Do not add ads, paywalls, or a daily question cap.
- Do not add paid SDKs. The monthly technical budget is locked.
- Database, auth, RLS, and account-deletion changes need explicit founder review before they touch production.
- One focused pull request. Leave it unmerged until a founder approves production.
